reserveReview.rationale: Classification-only review of exact keyed live accounting rows. Fresh pinned reads at Ethereum block 26282914 (hash 0x748ac3086a5b99e61d6a72dffd1d57911554c9f144826ad8fc08c72a774cafe0, timestamp 2026-10-27T08:41:47Z): Spark V2 documentation identifies Ethereum spUSDC 0x28b3a8fb53b741a8fd78c0fb9a6b2393d896a43d (proxy implementation 0x1b992302652a92611dcd5090d1cb388c6377f455) with underlying USDC. totalAssets() is 298,739,690.013720 USDC, the vault's idle USDC balance is 9,999,295.251975 and assetsOutstanding() is 288,740,394.761745, which sum exactly to totalAssets(); the idle share is 3.347160% and the deployed claim 96.652840%. TAKER_ROLE granted to Spark Liquidity Layer deploys funds externally, so the aggregate deployed claim is a protocol-position against Spark Liquidity Layer / Sky ecosystem, not a measured portfolio of constituent USDS or individual strategies. This review does not supply a deployed realization bound or infer legal custody safeguards.
